items.statement: The validated calculation determines the relative thermodynamic stability of structure 50 and structure S20 within the submitted model.
items.expected: For completed status, the report states the sign and magnitude of G(S20)-G(50), identifies the lower structure, and limits interpretation to thermodynamic preference rather than kinetics. For bounded_failure, it honestly identifies the failed structure(s), cause and partial quantities and does not invent a difference.
